# SaaS onboarding flow

*Client industry: SaaS | Completed: 2025-06-13 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p06*

## The problem
The client was a B2B tool losing trial users on day one.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Next.js, TypeScript, utility-first styling, PostgreSQL. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project raised trial activation from 22% to 37%.
